reviews.text: A fantastic place that my puppy loves
A large and beautiful family composed of super-complimentary instructors with a single goal: the well-being of the dog and a pleasant relationship with the human

Branco Sporting Club is an excellent dog training center, where professionalism, passion, and respect for dogs are key.
The instructors are competent, patient, and helpful.
Highly recommended for those seeking a reliable, welcoming environment that cares about animal welfare.
Excellent!! At BRANCO you will find professionalism, unique experience in the world of dog breeding, hospitality and much more; entering "BRANCO" is like entering a Formula One team 🐾🐾🦮 …

Professionals, welcoming environment for my dogs, I couldn't have chosen a better place and coach. 5 stars are nothing compared to what they deserve. A family environment where the well-being of our four-legged friends is considered first and foremost. They are respected and directed towards the most suitable sports for them after obviously careful educational paths.

A well-maintained center with excellent fields and qualified instructors, always up-to-date and ready to put their full effort into training the pairs. I arrived at the Branco less than a year ago with two adult dogs and two puppies to introduce to the sport. Four dogs with different personalities and temperaments are trained at this center, showcasing their strengths and unique abilities. There's a lot of attention to the dogs' well-being and our growth as athletes and responsible owners. I've traveled extensively and finally feel at home!
Excellent dog training center, very well trained and professional
Super-equipped dog training center. Francesca is extremely knowledgeable and helpful.

Il Branco is much more than a dog training center: it's a place where passion, expertise, and love for dogs come together to create a unique experience. The training grounds are meticulously maintained, and Francesca, along with her extraordinary team, oversees each pair with dedication and ongoing training. The center offers comprehensive training, rehabilitation, and sports (agility, rally-o, nosework, and swimming), always with a deep focus on the dog's well-being. Impeccable management and an atmosphere that makes you feel part of a big family. My dogs can't wait to come back every time!
Francesca manages the center impeccably, professionally and with a lot of love.
My dog ​​and I have been going to the Branco dog training center for a long time, and we've always had a great time. Everyone is very good.
Fantastic dog training center! All the instructors are knowledgeable, professional, and very kind.
Extremely competent and equipped for dog sports. A truly wonderful experience.

I had the misfortune of going to this center because I was having serious problems with my dog, problems that were not resolved at all. 10 lessons for 600 euros, training through an internet site because the trainer was afraid, throwing sausages at him and making him sit, and then in the end it was my dog's fault. In fact, I was recommended a behaviorist who, to tell me that my dog ​​must take a load of medication or simply be put down, took 150 euros from me. And a year later, having found a competent person without medication, my dog ​​is still alive and in excellent health, and all the problems were resolved simply with the expertise of a person who took my dog ​​to heart, honest in their financial compensation and giving me results I no longer believed in. To help their dogs, people make financial sacrifices, energy and many other things that are not taken into account. The important thing is to put that money in your pocket and goodbye and thank you. And a year later I'm still pissed off because if you had just told me that your dog needs more, it would have been appreciated and noteworthy.
Top dog training center. Highly qualified staff.
